meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 装上后,当你把文章、笔记、主题或简报等文字交给 Claude,它会把这个文字变成一部“无脸解说视频”的工作流程:生成逐帧故事板、脚本、配音和动画帧,最终渲染出 MP4。所有画面都是按场景凭空设计的,不需要真实素材。
howto.when: 当你想把文章、笔记或主题变成一部无脸解说视频时,如做主题解说、概念讲解、操作教程等场合;产品宣传类视频不会走这个技能。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一部无脸解说视频
say.note: Claude会先确认brief,再生成故事板和脚本

say.text: 根据这些笔记,做一个概念讲解视频的故事板
say.note: 它会规划逐帧教学计划并请你审阅

say.text: 写一段三分钟教程的解说脚本并渲染成视频
say.note: 会走完整的音画生成流程,最终产出MP4

howto.what_en: When you give Claude text (an article, notes, a topic, or a brief), it turns that into a faceless explainer video: it produces a frame-by-frame storyboard, script, narration, and animated frames, then renders an MP4. All visuals are invented per scene — no real footage or site capture.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn arbitrary text into a faceless explainer video, especially for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, or listicles. Not for product-launch videos.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the brief, then draft storyboard and script

say_en.text: Make a storyboard for a concept explainer from these notes
say_en.note: It plans a frame-by-frame teaching flow and asks for review

say_en.text: Write a 3-minute tutorial voiceover script and render the video
say_en.note: Runs the full audio-visual pipeline and outputs an MP4
